optimizedDescription.value: Vitest strategy: unit tests (domain/application, mocked ports) + integration tests (infrastructure, temp filesystem). No snapshots.

optimizedContext.value:
# Testing Conventions

## Rules
- Vitest only; tests in `test/` mirroring `src/`; `change.ts` → `test/.../change.spec.ts`
- Unit tests: every use case + entity invariant method; mocked ports; no fs/network
- Port mocks: fully implement interface; no `as unknown as Port`; unused methods throw `new Error('not implemented')`
- Integration tests: infrastructure adapters against real temp dir (`os.tmpdir()` + unique subfolder); cleanup after each test
- Naming: `.spec.ts` suffix; descriptions `"given <state>, when <action>, then <outcome>"`; helpers `setup<Thing>`/`cleanup<Thing>`
- No snapshot tests

## Constraints
- Vitest framework
- Tests in test/ not co-located
- `.spec.ts` suffix
- Unit tests: no fs/network/spawn
- Full port interface on mocks
- Integration tests clean temp dirs
- `toMatchSnapshot`/`toMatchInlineSnapshot` forbidden
